description: This is a FastAPI backend service for uploading, listing, downloading, streaming, and deleting video files stored in an upload directory. It includes models for video metadata, handles file validation and storage, and provides REST API endpoints for video management.

classes.name: VideoMetadata
classes.description: Pydantic model representing metadata of a video file, including filename, type, size, and upload timestamp.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Pydantic response model for upload operation, including filename, URL, and metadata.

classes.name: ListVideosResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model for listing multiple videos with total count and items.

methods.name: bool _is_allowed_file(filename: str)
methods.description: Checks if a filename has an extension permitted for upload (.mp4, .avi, .mov, .mkv).

methods.name: str _safe_destination_name(original_name: str)
methods.description: Generates a safe filename for storage, prefixed with a timestamp to avoid collisions.

methods.name: VideoMetadata _build_file_metadata(file_path: Path, original_content_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a VideoMetadata object for a given file path, including size, MIME type, and upload time.

methods.name: UploadResponse upload_video(file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Video file to upload (.mp4, .avi, .mov, .mkv)"))
methods.description: Handles uploading a video file, saves it to the upload directory, and returns its metadata and download URL.

methods.name: ListVideosResponse list_videos( ext: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional extension filter (e.g., mp4, avi). Do not include leading dot."), limit: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, ge=1, le=1000, description="Optional maximum number of items to return."), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set."), )
methods.description: Returns a list of uploaded videos with optional filtering by extension, pagination via limit and offset.

methods.name: VideoMetadata get_video_metadata( filename: str = FPath(..., description="Exact stored filename") )
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific video file by filename.

methods.name: download_video( filename: str = FPath(..., description="Exact stored filename") )
methods.description: Streams the requested video file for download.

methods.name: stream_video( filename: str = FPath(..., description="Exact stored filename") )
methods.description: Streams the requested video file in chunks. Does not support HTTP Range requests.

methods.name: delete_video( filename: str = FPath(..., description="Exact stored filename to delete") )
methods.description: Deletes a specified video file from the upload directory.
